purpose: Use independently acquired prospective first-party official rider-level PRE to falsify or constrain the already-frozen R0/R1/R2 Digital Twin worlds without choosing metrics after seeing the sensor sample and without using sporting outcomes.

input_contract.scientific_rows: only races admitted by independent_official_pre_sensor_validator_v1 under the quality amendment
input_contract.field_complete_rule: A race contributes to a field-specific metric only when all seven rider rows contain that field directly from the admitted official racecard.

synthetic_reference_generation.generator_code: frozen PR12 reviewed/result-generating implementation only; no coefficient or generator change
synthetic_reference_generation.environment_fields_not_measured_by_senso: excluded from realism comparison rather than inferred

univariate_distance.zero_iqr_policy: If synthetic IQR is <=1e-12, report UNINFORMATIVE_CONSTANT_REFERENCE unless real values differ, in which case report HARD_SUPPORT_MISMATCH.

small_sample_self_consistency_calibratio.purpose: Judge real-vs-world distance against the distance that the same frozen world naturally produces for a sensor batch of the same size, rather than using arbitrary absolute thresholds.
small_sample_self_consistency_calibratio.replicate_sample_size: exact number of official field-complete races for that metric
small_sample_self_consistency_calibratio.sampling: without replacement from the 10000-race frozen synthetic reference when possible
small_sample_self_consistency_calibratio.reference_comparison: each pseudo-sensor batch versus the remaining/reference synthetic world under the identical metric
small_sample_self_consistency_calibratio.reported_quantity: SELF_CONSISTENCY_PERCENTILE = fraction of pseudo-sensor distances >= official-sensor distance
small_sample_self_consistency_calibratio.semantics: This is an engineering self-consistency percentile, not a classical p-value and not proof of reality equivalence.

multivariate_joint_check.standardization: use frozen-world synthetic mean and std per feature; zero-variance features excluded before projection
multivariate_joint_check.projection_family: fixed random sign vectors normalized to unit L2 norm
multivariate_joint_check.self_consistency: same 200 pseudo-sensor replicate procedure and percentile thresholds as univariate distance

world_level_summary.minimum_condition_for_any_world_compatib: at least 8 admitted races with always-required class/score feature contract

label_rule.MATERIAL_TENSION: at least two primary feature metrics have SELF_CONSISTENCY_PERCENTILE < 0.01, or a hard support mismatch occurs
label_rule.TENSION: not MATERIAL_TENSION and at least two primary feature metrics have percentile < 0.05
label_rule.NOT_FALSIFIED: minimum sample met and neither MATERIAL_TENSION nor TENSION rule fires

world_level_summary.joint_check_role: reported separately as corroborating or conflicting evidence; it cannot silently override the preregistered primary label rule

post_receipt_rule.if_all_worlds_show_material_tension: preregister a new Digital Twin revision using only the frozen official sensor receipt as stated calibration/falsification evidence; do not retroactively alter R0/R1/R2
post_receipt_rule.if_multiple_worlds_not_falsified: retain uncertainty; do not select one by smallest distance on this batch alone
